name: inventra-api-docs
description: Tooling-only package: pins Spectral (and its @asyncapi/specs transitive dep) so the OpenAPI lint is reproducible in CI. @asyncapi/specs 6.11.x ships an ESM/CJS mismatch that crashes under Node 24 when pulled fresh via npx, so it is overridden to a known-good version and locked here. fast-uri is pinned to 3.1.7 to clear the SSRF, host-confusion and IDN-canonicalization advisories in <3.1.6 (transitive via Spectral's ajv; CI-lint tooling only). brace-expansion is pinned to 1.1.18 to clear GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, staying on the 1.x line that Spectral's minimatch@3 needs.
